facts.business: Microse India Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) that holds investments in equity shares, including delisted securities.

auditor.name: Todarwal & Todarwal LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The Company, being an NBFC, presented financial results in the format prescribed for companies other than Banks and NBFCs (Annexure I) instead of the prescribed format for NBFCs (Annexure II of SEBI Circular No. CIR/IMD/DF1/9/2015).

key_risks: Valuation and write-off of delisted equity shares due to absence of reliable or recoverable fair value
